Role Summary:

Are you passionate about real estate and possess excellent communication skills? We are seeking a motivated Commercial Agents to join our dynamic team. As a Commercial Agent, you will play a crucial role in promoting and managing property listings, engaging potential buyers, and facilitating successful transactions. This position requires a deep understanding of the Dubai real estate market, exceptional interpersonal skills, and a proactive approach to sales.

Key Responsibilities:

Evaluate and list properties, creating compelling listings. Build and maintain client relationships, providing market insights. Implement effective marketing strategies for property promotion. Represent clients during negotiations and ensure smooth closings. Prepare documents for property listings and coordinate with photographers. Provide weekly reports for landlords and sellers. Maintain listing quality score through verification and refresh.

Qualifications and Skills Required:

Proven experience in Commercial real estate. Deep understanding of Dubai real estate market. Excellent communication and negotiation skills. Proactive and detail-oriented.

Expected Start Date:

Immediately

Salary Range:

Commission
